content: {"episode_id":"ep-05006","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please reconsider the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, for which authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent presyncope and transient loss of consciousness without prodromal warning, raising concern for an underlying paroxysmal arrhythmia. Prior resting electrocardiograms were non-diagnostic, and mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these syncopal events with potential rhythm disturbances."}
